gap.reason: A semantic icon is chosen by meaning (status, action, object) rather than by glyph name. That needs a Framework contract that maps each meaning to a glyph, and the Framework does not publish one yet.
gap.fallback: Use the inline :icon[name]{label="..."} component with an explicit Material Symbols name, and give it a label when the icon carries meaning.
gap.admission: The Framework publishes the semantic icon contract in a release the Framework lock pins; Docara then adds a renderer, tests, a docs page with a live example and a catalogue entry, and removes this record.
